snapshot: Left WHO on 22 January 2026 and rebuilt its global health work around the State Department's America First Global Health Strategy: time-limited bilateral agreements with partner countries instead of large multilateral and USAID-run programmes.

agenda.title: Bilateral health agreements
agenda.text: The State Department has signed 36 bilateral health agreements with African countries and intends to sign about 70 in total. At least 11 require partners to share outbreak specimens and data within five days of a US request. The agreements are mostly unpublished. Zimbabwe lost all US health aid on 30 September after rejecting the terms, and Namibia will lose US HIV funding after 2027.

agenda.title: Outside WHO and the revised IHR
agenda.text: The United States has left WHO, has rejected the revised International Health Regulations, and with Israel and Argentina rejected a recent UN pandemic collaboration pledge. Member states of WHO aim to finalise the pathogen-sharing annex to the pandemic agreement by May 2027.

agenda.title: New CDC director
agenda.text: The Senate confirmed Erica Schwartz as CDC director on 5 August 2026 by 51 votes to 44. At her hearing she affirmed the safety of childhood vaccines and said she is all in on the Make America Healthy Again agenda.
